Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game. We could not get the second innings going and the match was called off due to rain. Bangladesh still lead 1-0 in this three-match ODI series, but will need to do all the work again in the next game to win the series while Ireland will try to put on a better performance and make it 1-1. The 3rd ODI will be played on 23rd March, Thursday at 2 pm IST (8.30 am GMT), but as you know you can join us early for the build-up. Cheers!

Sad news folks! The inevtiable has happened and this match is abandoned due to rain. The rain gods showed no mercy here and the covers did not have a chance to be taken off for once. Bangladesh will be disappointed with ths as they were in a great position to win this game and seal the series. They broke their own record of the highest ODI total for them which they literally created in the previous game. Mushfiqur Rahim also became the fastest Bangladeshi player to score an ODI hundred, but he will not be able to call it a match-winning innings. Ireland, on the other hand will feel like that rain was their saviour here as chasing 350 here would have been a really tough ask for them. They now have a chance to work on their mistakes and come back stronger in the 3rd ODI and try to finish the series on level terms.

Update - The rain has slowed down a bit, but the covers are still on. The cut-off time for a 20-over game is 9.03 pm IST (3.33 pm GMT), but the groundstaff will need to work hard to get the outfield ready in time. Let's hope for the best.

Update - 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT) - Nothing new to tell about. The rain is still falling down and the chances of starting this chase looks slim let alone having a full game. However, as you wait, you can switch tabs to catch our coverage of the Women's T20 League.

Update - 6.26 pm IST (12.56 pm GMT) - It is still raining and the visuals from the ground are not looking good. The covers are still on and it is very dark out there. However, the cut-off time is still far away and all we can do is wait and hope that we get some action.

Update - 6 pm IST (12.30 pm GMT) - Bad news folks! The run chase has been delayed for now as it is raining pretty heavily at the moment. The covers are on as well and we have to play the waiting game. Stay tuned for further updates.

Right then, Bangladesh have posted a huge total on the board with some scintillating batting display and will confident enough to defend this one. Ireland will need to bat their skins out if they are to get anywhere near this total. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie will need to give them a good start. Let's see how the chase unfolds.

For Ireland, it was the same story as the last game as the start was good but the spinners failed to impact the game and they lost he plot in the middle muddle. Graham Hume once against looked the brightest for them picking up three wickets, but he was not supported enough by other bowlers. Mark Adair and Curtis Campher took a wicket each. Their spinners were not effective, and it was a rude-awakening for the debutant, Matthew Humphreys as he turned out to be exepensive along with Andy McBrine. Their death bowling was also not up to the mark and allowed too many runs in the end.

The game started at a slow pace as openers Tamim Iqbal and Litton Das took their time to start scoring freely. A mix-up cost the wicket on Tamim right on the stroke of Powerplay 1 but it did not effect the scoring rate and Najmul Hossain Shanto and Litton kept scoring at a good pace. Litton, Shakib Al Hasan and Shanto fell in a cluster but the arrival of Mushfiqur Rahim and Towhid Hridoy sparked the Bangladesh innings again as they started scoring for fun. Rahim was sensational as he smashed a century and the opponent bowlers all around the park to help his side get to a massive total.

Take a bow, Mushfiqur Rahim! A blistering inning of high quality from him has helped the hosts post a mammoth total in the second ODI as well. We are halfway done with this game as Bangladesh has bettered their score from the first ODI and has broken their own record for the highest ODI total for them. Ireland has a daunting task in front of them if they are to level the series.

Yes, he can! HUNDRED FOR RAHIM! This is another low full toss, on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for single. This is the fastest ODI hundred for a Bangladesh player and celebrates like a wild man too. Bangladesh finishes on 349/6!
A low full toss, on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim whips it wide of long on for a brace. He moves to 99 now! Only one ball left. Can he do it?

FOUR! Cheeky and effective! Graham Hume misses th the yorker, and bowls a full toss, on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim moves across and reverse-scoops it over the short thrid man fence for a boundar. He moves to 97 now!
Full and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim whips it towards deep square leg and comes back for the second.
Full and on middle, Taskin Ahmed flicks it through square leg for a single. Mushfiqur Rahim is back on strike. He needs 9 runs for his hundred with four balls left.
Taskin Ahmed walks out next.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Graham Hume bowls this short and outside off, Yasir Ali tries to go for the big shot, but has to reach for it and slices it in the air behind point, Stephen Doheny from short third man runs to his left and takes a good catch. Bangladesh six down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Stephen Doheny b Graham Hume

Commentary.Commentary: Another short delivery, around leg, Mushfiqur Rahim tries to hook it, but misses. He is asking for the wide, but the umpire does not thinks so.

FOUR! Mushfiqur Rahim finds the fence now! Mark Adair serves this full and around off, Mushfiqur Rahim stays there and drives it wide of mid off for a boundary. This is now the highest ODI score for Bangladesh!
Mark Adair bangs this short and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim goes for the pull, but fails to connect.
Mark Adair nails the yorker now, on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim only manages to dig it out to the off side.
A slower one, short and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim waits for it to cut away, but gets an outside edge on the bounce towards the keeper.
Full and on leg, Yasir Ali misses his flick as the ball goes off his pads to the right of the bowler. A quick leg bye is taken.
A low full toss, on middle, Yasir Ali clips it towards deep mid-wicket for one more. A good end to the over from Hume!
Overpitched and on leg, angling in, Mushfiqur Rahim drills it towards long on for one.
Another good inswinging yorker, on middle, Yasir Ali digs it out through mid-wicket for a run.
Graham Hume bowls this in the blockhole, on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim squeezes it towards short third man for a single.
Fuller again and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim pushes it through covers for a brace.
FOUR! Powered away! Graham Hume serves this full and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim reaaches for it and bludgeons it wide of sweeper covers for a boundary falling over in the process as well.
A good yorker now, on off, Mushfiqur Rahim jams it out towards long off for one more.
A low full toss, on off, Yasir Ali drills it through covers for one.
FOUR! A fine shot to get off the mark! This is full and on off, Yasir Ali shows the full face of the bat to cream it through covers for a boundary.
Short of a length and on off, Yasir Ali chops it out towards the keeper.
Yasir Ali walks out next in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Mark Adair strikes! Towhid Hridoy misses out on his fifty by just one run. This is on a good length and around off, Towhid Hridoy goes for the drive on the up away from his body, and gets a thin inside edge towards the keeper where Lorcan Tucker makes no mistake. There is an appeal for that, and up goes the finger. Towhid Hridoy is looking not so confident, but still goes for the review. UltraEdge shows that there is bat involved and he has to go back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: A low full toss, on middle, Towhid Hridoy whips it wide of deep mid-wicket where the fielder covers his ground to the left and dives in to keep it inside. Two runs taken! However, the umpire wants to check it, and the replays shows that it is touch and go as as the toe of the fielder hits the ropes as soon as he relaeses the ball. The umpire thinks it is good and signals no boundary.
Another good yorker, on leg, angling in, Mushfiqur Rahim only manages to jam it out back to the bowler.
Curtis Campher bangs this short again and around off, Mushfiqur Rahim tries to ramp it away, but misses.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Curtis Campher lands this short and wide outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim frees his arms and muscles it over point for a boundary.
Curtis Campher nails the yorker, on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim digs it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, Towhid Hridoy works it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Towhid Hridoy joins the party! This is on a hard length and outside off, Towhid Hridoy slashes hard at it and the ball goes over short third man for a boundary.
Wide yorker, Mushfiqur Rahim slices this to cover-point.
FOUR! Innovation at it's very best. On a length around middle, Mushfiqur Rahim scoops this over the keeper for a boundary more.
Back of a length around middle, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller one outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim lofts this to deep extra cover for a single.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim slices this up and over the cover-point fielder for a boundary.
Yorker outside off, Towhid Hridoy edges this to short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Short-pitched delivery outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim stands tall and cuts this over short third for a boundary.

FOUR! After the finest of strokes, Mushfiqur Rahim plays the cheeky one too for a boundary. Fuller around middle, Mushfiqur Rahim scoops this over the keeper for a boundary. These two are toying with the field.
Back of a length around middle, Towhid Hridoy pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! That's right out of the tennis court. Short-pitched delivery around the head, Towhid Hridoy plays the short arm jab all the way for a boundary towards deep mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Mushfiqur Rahim drives this to extra cover for a single.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim lofts this over extra cover for a boundary. He has stepped on the paddle it seems.
Change of ends for Curtis Campher (8-0-46-1).
Back of a length around middle, Mushfiqur Rahim taps this to the off side and runs for it.
SIX! Batting of the highest order here. Short and wide outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts this over point for a maximum. Half-century for Mushfiqur Rahim.
FOUR! Full toss around off, Mushfiqur Rahim presents the full face of his bat and drives this through extra-cover for a boundary.
FOUR! A cracking stroke for yet another boundary. Short and wide of off, Mushfiqur Rahim gives himself a little bit of room by shuffling to his leg and cuts this over point for a boundary.
On a length drifting down leg, Towhid Hridoy flicks this to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length around middle, Mushfiqur Rahim pulls this flat to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller around middle, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to deep mid-wicket and runs a couple.
SIX! All the way for a maximum. Fuller around off, Towhid Hridoy slogs this off the front foot for a maximum over the sight screen. A gigantic hit for half-a-dozen runs.
Fuller on off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts this to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller around off, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to sweeper cover for a single.
Short in length on off, Mushfiqur Rahim hops onto his back foot and cuts this to sweeper cover for a single.
Short in length around middle, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller around off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts this to point.
Wide! Curtis Campher bends his back and darts one over Mushfiqur Rahim. Wide signaled.
Back of a length outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to slice this to third man but fails to connect.
Off-cutter on a length around middle, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to long on for a single.
On a length around off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts this to third man for a single.
FOUR! Short and wide of off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts this over point for a boundary. This was all about timing and placement.
Wide! Short-pitched delivery way over the batter. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Short and wide of off, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to cut but misses out. Fingers rolled over this delivery.
Powerplay 3! Now, fives fielders are allowed outside the circle till the last over.
Flatter, full and on off, Towhid Hridoy pushes it towards covers.
Short again and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim nudges it towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Up and over! This is short and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim shuffles across, and goes down to paddle-sweep it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Floated, and on middle, Towhid Hridoy uses his feet and eases it towards long on for another run.
Short again and on leg, Mushfiqur Rahim clips it towards short fine leg for a run.
Quicker, short and on leg, Towhid Hridoy flicks it through square leg for a single.
Another short delivery, on middle, Towhid Hridoy slaps it towards deep square leg for one more.
Short and on middle, Towhid Hridoy pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket where George Dockrell runs to his left and dives to keep it inside. Two runs taken!
On a length and around off, Towhid Hridoy pushes it wide of sweeper covers for a couple of runs.
Overpitched and on leg, Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it through square leg for one.

SIX! BOOM! Mushfiqur Rahim decides to go big now! Curtis Campher serves this a touch fuller and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim dances down the track and smashes it over the deep extra cover fence for a biggie.
Full and on middle, Towhid Hridoy clips it wide of mid on for a single.
BEAUTY! This is on a good lenght and around off, shaping away bit, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to play at it, but gets beaten on the outside edge again.
On a length and on off, Towhid Hridoy tucks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Short and on middle, Towhid Hridoy jabs it wide of long on for a couple of runs.
Full and on off, Towhid Hridoy knocks it to the left of the bowler.
Short and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length and on off, shaping away, Mushfiqur Rahim has a poke at it, but gets beaten by the extra bounce as the ball goes past the outside edge to the keeper.

FOUR! 14 runs off the over! Matthew Humphreys lands this short again and on middle, Towhid Hridoy moves back and thrashes it wide of mid on and beats the deep mid-wicket fielder as well for another boundary.
Goes short and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim forces it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Sweeps and sweeps for four! This is flighted, full and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim goes down and nails the sweep shot for a boundar towards the deep square leg fence.
Short again and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts it on the bounce towards point.
Floated, short and on off, Towhid Hridoy punches it towards sweeper covers for a single.
FOUR! Fine shot! This is tossed up and around middle, Towhid Hridoy skips down the track and slogs it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Short and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim pulls it hard and wide of deep square leg and comes back for the second.
Full and on off, Towhid Hridoy drives it wide short covers where the fielder dives to his right to make a half-stop as the ball rolls towards mid off. They cross.
Short and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
On a length and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim defends it towards short covers.
Back of a length and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim dabs it towards backward point.
Short and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts it well past point for a brace.
Flatter, full and on middle, Towhid Hridoy keeps it out to the off side.
Short again and around off, Towhid Hridoy slaps it straight to short covers.
Shortish and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim punches it towards sweeper covers for one.
Tossed up, full and on off, Towhid Hridoy pushes it through covers for a run.
Floated, full and on middle, Towhid Hridoy blocks it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts it towards sweeper covers for a single.
Short and around off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts it through cover-point for a run.

Touch fuller and on middle, shaping in again, Mushfiqur Rahim tries to work it away, but misses again to get hit on the pads. Another appeal for LBW, but the fineger stays down. This is going down the leg side just like the previous delivery.
This is on a good length and on middle, shaping in sharply, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to play at it, but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a stiffled appeal for LBW, but turned down.
Back of a length and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim nudges it through square leg for a couple of runs.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A soft dismissal, but Ireland won't mind that. Najmul Hossain Shanto has to walk back to the hut now. Graham Hume lands this on a hard length and around leg, angling in, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to flick it away, but only manages to glove it behind the wicket where Lorcan Tucker dives to his right to take a sharp catch. There is an appeal for caught behind, but the finger stays down. However, Najmul Hossain Shanto starts to walk and Ireland players celebrates. Bangladesh four down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Graham Hume

Commentary.Commentary: Andy McBrine comes into the attack.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks out next in the middle.
Graham Hume bangs in a bouncer, on off, but it goes way above the head of Najmul Hossain Shanto. Wided.
On a length and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it down the pitch.
A single to end the over as this short delivery is flicked through square leg by Shanto.
FOUR! Deft touch! This is quicker, short and around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto stays back, waits for it and just glides it past short third man for a boundary.
Flatter, full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto keeps it out in front of point.
Short again and on off, Towhid Hridoy cuts it through cover-point for a run and gets off the mark.
Short and around off, Towhid Hridoy bunts it towards backward point.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it towards long on for a single.
Towhid Hridoy comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! Graham Hume strikes! This is a huge wicket for Ireland as Shakib Al Hasan walks back to the hut now. Hume serves this full and outsdie off, slower too, Shakib Al Hasan makes room for the big shot, but has to reach for it. He still goes through it and gets a thick outside edge as the ball goes in the air towards backward point where Harry Tector settles under it and takes a nice catch. Is this the opening that Ireland were looking for?
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Graham Hume

Commentary.Commentary: A slower one now, on a length and on off, Shakib Al Hasan taps it down towards point again.
Back of a length and around off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts it towards point.
Graham Hume bangs this short and on middle, Shakib Al Hasan slaps it wide of deep mid-wicket where the fielder puts in a good dive to his right to keep it inside. Two runs taken!
On a length and on off, Shakib Al Hasan dabs it towards point and denies the run.
Back of a length and around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto punches it towards sweeper covers for a single.

Time for a Drinks break. Bangladesh is in pole position with 8 wickets still in hands. The platform is perfectly laid for the middle order to come and smash from ball one. Ireland needs to be careful and would be hoping not the repeat the same mistake they did in the first game. Ireland needs to see the back of these two if they want to chase something below 300.
Floated, full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it towards long off for one.
Another single as this short delivery is slapped down to long on by Shakib.
Short again and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it through point for another run.
Short and on middle, Shakib Al Hasan moves back and pushes it towards long on for a run.
Flatter, short and around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it towards sweeper covers for a single.

Good fielding in the deep! This is floated and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto advances down the track and drills it wide of long on where Mark Adair covers his ground quickly and dives to his right to stop it. Two runs taken!
Short and wide of off, Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts this to backward point for a single.
Off-beak just outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to guide this to third man but gets beaten.
Fuller one outside off, Shakib Al Hasan drills this to long on for a single.
FOUR! The dancing shoes are on today for Shakib Al Hasan. Fuller one on off, Shakib Al Hasan advances down the track and drills this past the bowler for a boundary.
Quicker and fuller on off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts this late to point.
Fuller one in middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto works this to short mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to slog but mishits this near the square on off. No run taken.
Fuller one on off, Shakib Al Hasan drives this to mid off for no run.
FOUR! Depth touch for a boundary. Short and wide of off, Shakib Al Hasan hops on his back foot and cuts this late to the fence at the third man region.
Fuller and quicker on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto edges this to square leg for a signle.
SIX! That's a beauty. Tossed up in middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto dances down the ground and lofts this as straight as an arrow over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Tossed up in middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto slog sweeps this to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Back of a length on off, Shakib Al Hasan defends this off the back foot.
Bye, Full and wide of off, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to cut but misses out. The ball dies on the keeper and he fails to collect this cleanly. They run a single of byes.
Fuller one angling down leg, Shakib Al Hasan works this to the deep on the on side for a single.
On a length around middle, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this near the square on the on side.
Wide! On a length growing down leg, Shakib Al Hasan looks to poke but fails to connect. Wide signaled.
Short-pitched delivery on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls this flat and hard to deep mid-wicket for a single. Half-century for Shanto.
Back of a length around pads, Shakib Al Hasan tucks this to short fine leg for a single.
Quickr and flatter around off, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to long off for a single.
Fuller one around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto smashes this back to the bowler who deflects this to long off and they take a single.
Tossed up on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto drives this back to the bowler.
Tossed up in middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this off the front foot.
Fuller one on off, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes this wide of short cover for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan comes out to the middle now. Also, Andy McBrine (4-0-24-0) replaces Matthew Humphreys.

OUT! TAKEN! On a length around middle, Litton Das flicks this and lands one straight in the hands of Andy McBrine at short mid-wicket. A soft dismissal against the run of play. Ireland needed to break this partnership and Curtis Campher has done the needful.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy McBrine b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide of off, Najmul Hossain Shanto slices this wide of point. Harry Tector does brilliant to dives and get a hand on this as he saves a boundary here. Single taken.
Short-pitched delivery head high, Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller one wide of off, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this off the front foot.
Short and wide outside off, Litton Das pushes this to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length around off, Litton Das defends this to point.
Curtis Campher (4-0-17-0) comes back into the attack now.
Fuller one in middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes this back to the bowler for no run.
Tossed up on pads, Litton Das works this to square leg for a single.
Fuller around middle, Litton Das defends this off the front foot.
Fuller around middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks this to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! An excellent stroke for four. Short in length outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pounces on this and drills this past the cover region for a boundary.
Fuller one on pads, Litton Das pushes this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and fuller around middle, Litton Das works this to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery deserved to be punished and Litton Das grabs the opportunity to smash a boundary. Short in length on pads, Litton Das pulls this to deep square leg for a boundary.
Short in length on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts this to point and takes a quick single.
A bit of grip and turn on pads, Litton Das tucks this to deep square for a single.
Fuller on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto slogs this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted outside off, Litton Das smashes this to short cover for a single. A misfield allows the run.
Fuller outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto slices this to backward point for a couple.
Fuller one with no room on offer, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes this back to the bowler.
Short in length around pads, Litton Das milks this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length dragged back a bit outside off, Litton Das cuts this but finds the fielder at point.
Fuller one in middle, Litton Das pushes this back to he bowler.
Short in length around middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto hops onto his back foot and smashes this to long on for a single.
Fuller one in middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto milks this to square leg for a single.
Fuller one wide of off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes this to short third man for no run.
Tossed up on pads, Litton Das tucks this to square leg for a single.
Short and wide of off, Litton Das cuts this just wide of the fielder at point for a couple of runs.
Tossed up on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes this to short cover and steals a single.
Fuller one of off, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this to short cover.
Fuller one on off, Litton Das defends this off the front foot for no run.
Tossed up around middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes this to long on for a single.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto smashes this past mid off for a boundary. A cracking stroke for a boundary.
Short in length on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto smashes this to short mid-wicket for no run.
Fuller one on pads, Litton Das tucks this to square leg for a single.

SIX! The debutant is finding out what it feels like to play against the best. Half-tracker on off, Litton Das gets on his back foot and pulls this over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Half-century for Litton Das.
Fires this one short and on leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Shortish and around leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto nudges it towards deep square leg an comes back for the second easily in the end. Good runnng!
Flighted, full and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends it on the front foot.

SIX! Najmul Hossain Shanto breaks the shackles! This is floated, full and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto goes down on one knee and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 100 up for Bangladesh!
Quicker, short and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to cut it, but misses. This is a good battle going on.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto uses his feet, but miscues his slog wide of deep mid-wicket for a brace.

SIX! BANG! Litton Das goes big now! Matthew Humphreys bowls this short again and on middle this time, Litton Das quickly moves onto his back foot and heaves it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 14 runs off the over! That also bring up the 50-run partnership between these two batters.
FOUR! Nice shot! Matthew Humphreys lands this short again, outside off, Litton Das makes some room and waits for it to cut it past the diving cover-point fielder for a boundary.
Shortish and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto moves back and punches it towards mid off for one.
Flatter, full and on leg, Litton Das tucks it towards square leg for another run.
Quicker, full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto steers it towards point for a quick run.
Short and on middle, Litton Das nudges it through square leg for a single.
Darts this one full and on off, Litton Das eases it towards long on for one more.
Quicker, full and on leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to drive it, but gets an inside edge through square leg for a run.
Flatter, short and on off, Litton Das pushes it through covers for a single.
Flighted, full and on middle, Litton Das reverse sweeps it straight towards short third man.
Floated, short and on off, Litton Das waits for it and guides it very late towards third man region for two more.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Litton Das clips it uppishly but wide of square leg for a couple of runs.
Short and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto slaps it towards mid-wicket.
Touch fuller and around off, Litton Das punches it throgh covers for one.
Curtis Campher bangs this short and on middle, Litton Das tries to pull it away, but misses as the ball deflects off his elbow onto his lower stomach area. That is going to hurt.
On a length and on off, Litton Das pushes it towards short covers.
This is on a hard length and on leg, angling in, Najmul Hossain Shanto glances it through square leg for a run.
Short of a length and outside off, Litton Das cuts it towards deep point for a single.

Time for a Drinks break. Bangladesh started off brilliantly as the openers got through the initial stage when the ball was moving like a pendulum without any causality. The wicket of Tamim Iqbal due to a mix-up was the only low for the hosts in the first 16 overs. Ireland missed a trick early on as they bowled a lot shorter to the openers in these conditions that favored the seamers. The game is well poised at this point and both teams would be happy with the proceedings so far.
Floated, full and on leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto goes for the sweep again, but gets a top edge as the ball goes on the bounce towards short fine leg.
Flatter, short and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it back to the bowler.
Another short delivery, on middle, Litton Das clips it through mid-wicket for one.
Short again and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto nudges it towards square leg for another run.
Short and on middle, Litton Das flicks it off the back foot through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto sweeps it wide of short fine leg where the fielder dives to his right to stop it. A single is taken.
This is pitched up, on middle, Litton Das clips it wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Short and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it wide of point where Harry Tector dives to his right and gets a hand to it as the ball rolls to the left of the keeper. They cross.
Fuller one and on middle, shaping in, Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it to the left of the bowler.
Back of a length and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it wide of short mid-wicket where the fielder gathers it up quickly, Litton Das wants the run, but is sent back and rightly so.
Short of a length and outsdie off this time, Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to cut it away, but fails to connect.
Goes short, but down the leg side, Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves it alone. Wided.
Back of a length and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto knocks it back to the bowler.
Short again and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it towards sweeper covers for one.
Shortish and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto moves back and punches it wide of short covers where the fiedler dives to his left to stop it.
Floated, full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto keeps it out to the off side.
Flatter, full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto stays back and gets hurried as he mistimes his cut towards point.
Quicker, short and on off, Litton Das pushes it through covers for a run.
Andy McBrine starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto drills it towards long off for a single.
Andy McBrine relaces the debutant after just one over.
This is on a hard length and around off, Litton Das stands tall and punches it wide of deep point and comes back for the second.
Short and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length and on off, Litton Das pushes it with the outer half towards third man for a run.
Is that a drop? Yes, it is. This is short and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it uppishly towards point where the fielder tries to go down quickly, but the ball just goes under his hands.
Curtis Campher nails the yorker this time, on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto digs it out towards short mid-wicket.
Short of a length and outside off, angling away, Najmul Hossain Shanto slashes, but misses.
A single to end the over as this short delivery it flicked through square leg by Shanto.
Tossed up, full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it wide of long off for a brace.
Just short! Matthew Humphreys continues to bowl short, on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto moves abck ad tucks it uppishly towards shrot mid-wicket, but it falls just short.
Another short delivery, on off, Litton Das cuts it towards deep point for a run.
Short again and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto nudges it off the back foot wide of short mid-wicket for a run.
Matthew Humphreys begins with a short delivery, on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto moves back and forces it towards short mid-wicket.
Debutant Matthew Humphreys comes into the attack now.
Fullish and on leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it through square leg for one.
Short of a length and around off, Litton Das gets surprsied by the extra bounce, but manages to guide it past point for another run.
Back of a length and on off, Litton Das punches it towards short covers again.
On a length and on off, Litton Das pushes it towards short covers.
Fuller one and on middle, shaping in, Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it towards short mid-wicket for a run.
Goes a bit fuller and around off, Litton Das steers it towards deep point for a single.
Curtis Campher starts off with a wide! He bowls this back of a length, but well outside off, Litton Das leaves it alone. Wided.

Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 players outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Najmul Hossain Shanto walks out to bat at number 3. Curtis Campher comes into the attack for Ireland as well.

OUT! RUN-OUT! Fuller one around pads, Litton Das flicks this to short fine leg and runs for this, the skipper Tamim Iqbal runs too and is well short of his crease. A mix-up between the two experienced heads of Bangladesh gifts the visitors their first wicket. Brilliant fielding effort by Mark Adair as he hits the bull's eye.
On a length around middle, Tamim Iqbal tucks this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Tamim Iqbal drives this and finds the fielder at extra cover for no run.
FOUR! Skipper is gaining confidence with each stroke. Overpitched outside off, Tamim Iqbal plays the cover drive to perfection for a boundary.
Fuller one outside off, Litton Das drives this wide of mid off for a single.
On a length around middle, Litton Das pushes this to short mid-wicket for no run.
FOUR! Too short and wide of off, Tamim Iqbal hops on his back foot and carves this away from the fielder at cover-point for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Tamim Iqbal hits this from the inside of his bat as the short mid-wicket collects this.
Short-pitched delivery body bound, Tamim Iqbal pulls this and finds the fielder at square leg for no run.
Fortune favoring the brave here. Fuller one around off, Tamim Iqbal loses his body shape as he looks to slog this. Tamim Iqbal gets a leading edge that falls short of third man and they run a couple.
On a length around middle, Tamim Iqbal defends this solidly from behind for no run.
Short and wide outside off, Tamim Iqbal cuts this off the back foot towards point.
Full and wide outside off, Tamim Iqbal drives this wide of mid off and takes a single. 12 runs coming off the 8th over.
Fuller around pads, Tamim Iqbal tucks this on the on side but finds the fielder at short mid-wicket.
On a length going down leg, Litton Das flicks this to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length around waist, Litton Das defends this off the front foot.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. On a length around pads, Litton Das charges down the wicket and slogs this to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! First maximum of the day. Fuller one on off, Litton Das shimmies down the track and lofts this over cover for a maximum. Runs beginning to flow now.
Full and wide of off, Tamim Iqbal leaves this too.
Fuller one swinging away from the batter, Tamim Iqbal leaves this for the keeper to collect.
Back of a length on top of off, Tamim Iqbal pushes this to mid off for no run.
FOUR! First stroke in aggression and a fruitful one too. Fuller one around off, Tamim Iqbal advances down the track and smashes this over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Tamim Iqbal leaves this for the keeper.
That's a perfect length to a left-hander. On a length around that corridor of uncertainty, Tamim Iqbal gets forward to defend but gets beaten on his outside edge.
Fuller one around off, Litton Das gets a thickish edge that falls in front of point for no run.
Full and wide of off, Litton Das leaves this for the keeper to collect.
Back of a length around off, Litton Das pushes this to point. Harry Tector fields brilliantly to save a certain boundary.
On a length outside off, Litton Das walks down the track to defend but gets beaten.
On a length outside off, Litton Das advances down the track for a big heave but misses out completely.
On a length outside off, Litton Das defends this off the front foot.
Leg bye. On a length around the waist, Litton Das clips this off his pads to square leg for a single.
Inswinging full toss on middle, Tamim Iqbal flicks this to fine leg for a single.
Fuller one outside off, Tamim Iqbal leaves this for the keeper to collect.
FOUR! First boundary of the game as Tamim Iqbal flicks this fine. Fuller around pads, Tamim Iqbal has flicked this to fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller one around off, Litton Das looks to flick across the line but gets a top edge going past the cover-point region for 3 runs.
Fuller one around middle, Litton Das tucks this to short mid-wicket for no run.
Fuller one angling away from the batter, Tamim Iqbal leaves this for the keeper to collect.
Fuller one outside off, Tamim Iqbal drives this and finds the fielder at cover for no run. Good effort in the field.
Short and wide of off, Litton Das guides this to third man for a single.
Back of a length around off, Litton Das pushes this to cover-point for no run.
On a length outside off, Litton Das defends this to short cover.
On a length around pads, Tamim Iqbal tucks this wide of square leg and takes a single.
Full and wide outside off, Litton Das lets this go. Back-to-back maiden overs.
Back of a length on top of middle, Litton Das defends this back to the bowler.
Full and wide outside off, Litton Das leaves this all alone for the keeper to collect.
Back of a length around off, Litton Das gets behind this and defends this of the front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Litton Das looks to defend this but gets beaten on his outside edge. Mark Adair is bowling on a perfect spot.
Ona length outside off, Litton Das looks to block but gets beaten by the late movement.
Fuller around off, Tamim Iqbal strides forward and defends this for no run. Maiden over to start for Graham Hume.
Full and wide outside off, Tamim Iqbal looks to drive but mishits this back to the bowler for no run.
On a length around pads, Tamim Iqbal defends this in front of square on the on side.
Fuller around middle, Tamim Iqbal tucks this to square leg for no run.
Touch fuller around off, Tamim Iqbal blocks this out solidly from behind.
On a length outside off, Tamim Iqbal leans ahead to block but gets hit on his glove.
Who will bowl from the other end?
On a length outside off, Litton Das looks to defend but gets beaten on his outside edge.

Buzzers! This is on a good length and on middle, shaping in, Litton Das looks to block it, but gets an inside edge towards square leg as the batters sets off for the run, the fielder hits the stumps at the batter's end as the ball deflects to the deep and the batters steal another run.
Back of a length around middle, Litton Das defends this off the front foot for no run.

Fuller one around pads with a bit of movement on this, Litton Das looks to tuck this on the on side but gets beaten as the ball has hit his front pad. Loud appeal from the visitors but the umpire has turned this down. Andy Balbirnie asks for a review here. The ultra-edge shows a spike when the ball passes his bat hence Ireland loses a review and the umpire has been asked to stay with his original decision.
Fuller around middle, Tamim Iqbal gets behind this and flicks this to fine leg for a single. Tamim Iqbal gets off the mark and so does Bangladesh.
On a length around pads, Tamim Iqbal looks to play across but gets a leading edge to point for no run. A hint of movement early on.

We are all set to start! The players are already out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Litton Das are the two openers for Bangladesh. Mark Adair has the new ball in hand and in raring to go. Let's play...

Tamim Iqbal, the captain of Bangladesh says that they would have bowled first as well. Adds that they have been doing quiet well and there are one or two players reting for them. Tells that he don't really sets targets and says they will have to bat well in the first 15 overs and then take it from there.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland says they will bowl first as the conditions are a bit more overcast and the wicket has been undercover so a bit more movement early on. On missing key players he says that the workload needs to be managed and the players missing out is not an issue as it gives opportunities to other players. We have got one change as Matthew Humphreys makes his ODI debut.

PITCH REPORT - Athar Ali Khan is pitchside. He says that the conditions are a bit gloomy and overcast with a lot of cloud cover. Adds that there is a bit of grass on it and it usually is good for batting. Tells that the seamers can get some help of they pitch in the right areas.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Litton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Shakib Al Hasan, Towhid Hridoy, Yasir Ali, Taskin Ahmed, Ebadot Hossain, Nasum Ahmed, Hasan Mahmud (In for Mustafizur Rahman).

Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Stephen Doheny, Andy Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, Lorcan Tucker (WK), George Dockrell, Andy McBrine, Mark Adair, Matthew Humphreys (In for Gareth Delany and On Debut), Graham Hume.
TOSS - Ireland have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

Ireland on the other hand would be looking to forget the last game and take this game as a fresh start. The bowlers did well to start off but the inability to capitalize on a good start cost them the game. Youngster Stephen Doheny looked good along with Paul Stirling at the top but the others need to chip in as well if they want to challenge Bangladesh. A lot would depend on the top-order batters as they have to give them a good start to sway away any doubts amongst the batters in the squad. Let us see if Bangladesh can clinch the series in this game itself or will the visitors bring it back on level terms. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.

It was a one-sided affair in the first ODI as Ireland was dominated by the hosts. Towhid Hridoy and Shakib Al Hasan laid the perfect platform for the likes of Mushfiqur Rahim and Co. to follow and they did exactly what was required of them and the bowling took care of the rest. In the second ODI, the hosts would love to get their top order back in form especially skipper Tamim Iqbal as he has been searching for some runs recently. Their bowling has been the brightest and the bowlers are delivering on a regular basis and will look to maintain that and get another win.

Hello and welcome to the second ODI of this 3-match ODI series between Bangladesh and Ireland. Sylhet International Cricket Stadium will be hosting this game. Bangladesh is coming into this game with its heads held high after a comprehensive victory against the visitors and will look to seal the series in this game while Ireland will look for some inspiration and hope to put up a better performance to level the series.
...MATCH DAY...

After a brilliant victory in the first ODI, Bangladesh will be stepping out against Ireland at Sylhet International Cricket Stadium, Sylhet for the second ODI on Monday.In the first ODI Bangladesh ran riots as they defeated the visitors by a margin of 183 runs. The hosts were in a situation of bother at the start losing key wickets in a cluster but a sensational knock by debutant Towhid Hridoy of 92 runs and the experienced head of Shakib Al Hasan helped the team to score 338 and that proved to be way too much for Ireland. No batter stood up and took responsibility in the run chase in the first ODI. Bangladesh would be looking to better the top-order performance in the second game and would like to do the same with the bowling department. A lot would depend on Najmul Hossain Shanto who has been Mr. Consistent for them in the batting department. On the contrary, Ireland would be looking to put up a performance of some sort as they failed to impress in the previous game. A lot depends on the opening pair and the skipper of Ireland as they hold the key to setting up the pace for the batting unit. Ireland also needs to work on depth bowling. The game promises to be a cracker as these two giant killers collide against each other on Monday.
